target_customer: AI labs and large companies building speech and conversational audio models
problem: Voice AI lacks real, multi speaker conversational audio that captures turn taking and interruptions.
business_model: licensed and custom audio datasets sold to labs

founders.name: Ben Wiley
prior_employers: Scale AI (public sector GenAI platform engineering lead)

technical_complexity.rationale: Running global recording operations with multi channel quality control is operations heavy rather than research grade.

defensibility.rationale: Datasets and contributor network (about 40K contributors in 2026 per a profile) compound, though rivals can collect similar audio.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not shown; David AI grew rapidly through 2025 per press.

market_need_then: Voice AI labs needed conversational audio; the first customer was a robotics company per a profile; dated 2024 demand evidence not opened.

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a common first name; no sources describe the brand itself, but the research site and datasets are named consistently.

outcome_analysis: David AI, founded by two former Scale AI employees, joined YC in Summer 2024 and raised a 5 million seed, a 25 million Series A in May 2025 and a 50 million Series B in October 2025. It rode demand for voice AI training data and a founder network from the data labeling industry, and is still active.
notes: Seed date 2025-01 from Seedtable URL; amount and lead from the company site. A 500 million dollar post money for the Series B appears only in a search summary of Bloomberg and is not recorded. Seedtable lists BoxGroup as Series B lead; company and press say Meritech. Competitors named only in aggregator pages, not dated near founding. Founder education not found. No negative outcome events found.
